recap.text:
Newport Select Gold 14U Lead Beginning To End In Victory Over Eckstein
November 7, 2026 vs. Eckstein
Newport Select Gold 14U never trailed in their 51-26 victory over Eckstein on Saturday at Cedar Park Church.
Kalden Sen scored 18 points to lead Newport Select Gold 14U.
Leading 13-3, Newport Select Gold 14U went on a 21-point run to pull further away.
Newport Select Gold 14U scored at will in the paint. They went 21-39 on twos. Newport Select Gold 14U played stifling defense, blocking three shots and grabbing 19 steals. Newport Select Gold 14U rebounded the ball well, collecting 31 rebounds. Sen led the team with eight rebounds. Sen hit two threes for Newport Select Gold 14U. Newport Select Gold 14U passed the ball well with 10 assists on 24 made baskets. Sen led the team with six assists. Also contributing for Newport Select Gold 14U were Harry Zhang (10 points), Deacon Chun (9 points), Charles (8 points), and Aiden Shih (6 points).
Newport Select Gold 14U will travel to Monroe for their next game on Saturday.
